アートを愉しむギャラリーのようなリビングや音楽を愉しむための部屋など、都心のヴィ: A fine apartment renovation for making the most of life at Hiroo Garden Hills, a vintage block in the middle of the city: a living room like a gallery for enjoying art, a room for listening to music. Walnut flooring and charcoal-grey carpet give a masculine palette, while natural materials such as lime plaster keep the rooms from reading as merely cool. Wall panelling painted pale blue runs through the bedroom, the entrance and the living room, carrying the green and the sky from east to west through the glass.
「漆喰の家に住みたい」というご希望を叶えるため、リフォームを前提に物件探しから始: To answer a wish to live in a house of lime plaster, this couple began with the search for the apartment itself, renovation already in mind. A full skeleton renovation let the plan be reconsidered substantially, and the layout built from scratch around the way they live. Walls and ceilings in every room are finished in lime plaster; the floors are natural materials, wool-linen carpet and solid timber. A home for unhurried hours: comfortable air, the cherry blossom in view, and the Scandinavian furniture they chose.
北欧ヴィンテージやPoul Kjaerholm（ポール・ケアホルム）の家具など、: A fine apartment renovation where real things are shown at their best — Scandinavian vintage, furniture by Poul Kjærholm. Walls and ceilings finished in lime plaster, and a terrace deck in the same solid teak as the living room, join the home to its private garden and make an open, settled space. Niches are set into the limestone wall facing the entrance and into the living-room fireplace, so that something can be put out for each season. A home appointed with the ease of a detached house.

熟練職人の手により、なめらかでいて、味のある風合いに仕上げられた漆喰の壁はビニー: Laid by a skilled plasterer, smooth and yet full of character, a lime plaster wall does what vinyl wallcovering cannot: it takes the shadows of the lighting beautifully.
フローリングには一般的に使用されている木目調のプリントがされた合板(化学接着剤で: Flooring ranges from the common printed wood-grain plywood — wood waste bound with synthetic adhesive — to boards cut from a single piece of solid timber. The first has a glossy surface, and some are coated to resist scratching. They are easy to look after, but they do not last.
